> "shsoton" <shs...@dircon.co.uk> wrote:

This is correct per the recent errata [RTR 20000501] which makes all
master cards on a Banished vampire out of play. Prior to that, master
discipline cards counted towards the capacity you had to fill up to.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> one of my vampires with a master skill card gets banished. do i have to
> refill him to his printed capacity or to the increased new capacity?

Banishment [DS] - Political Action
* All cards on the uncontrolled vampire become uncontrolled as well, and
are not subject to contesting while out of play. These cards come back
into play when the vampire does. [RTR 20000501]

Since the skill card is out of play, it doesn't affect the capacity of the
vampire. You need refill him only to the printed capacity.
